content_units: Best Picks for a Brother Watchthrough
You want the best mix of   strong character arcs  ,   low fan service  ,   good dub availability  ,   not too depressing  , and a   first season under 12 hours  .
Based on those priorities, the best overall fit is   Mob Psycho 100  , with   Spy x Family   and   Haikyuu!!   close behind.
Rank   Anime   First Season Time   Character Arcs   Fan Service   Tone   Dub   Fit for You
1   Mob Psycho 100    5 hours   Excellent   Very low   Uplifting with emotional moments   Strong   Best overall balance
2   Spy x Family    10 hours   Good and growing   Very low   Light, warm, funny   Strong   Best easy shared watch
3   Haikyuu!!    10 hours   Excellent   Low   Energetic, inspiring   Good   Great if you want team growth
4   Death Note    8.5 hours   Strong, but less emotionally warm   Very low   Dark, tense   Strong   Great hook, but heavier mood
5   Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood    12+ hours   Excellent   Low   Emotional, sometimes dark   Excellent   Amazing series, slightly misses time target
6   Attack on Titan    10 hours   Strong   Very low   Very depressing and intense   Strong   Worst fit for your mood preference
Option 1:   Mob Psycho 100     Big character growth, almost no fan service, short first season, emotionally positive overall     Best match
Option 2:   Spy x Family     Easy to watch together, funny and heartfelt, low awkwardness, very approachable dub     Best casual pick
Option 3:   Haikyuu!!     Strongest team-driven arcs, highly motivating, low fan service, great sibling-friendly energy     Best sports pick
-   Character arcs:   One of the best in anime. Mob’s growth feels genuine, steady, and satisfying.
-   Tone:   Emotional but not bleak; it stays humane and often uplifting.
-   Time:   Easiest first season to finish quickly.
Why it wins: it hits   all five   of your priorities better than any other option.
-   Character arcs:   Not as deep in season 1 as the top picks, but the family dynamic develops very well.
-   Tone:   Warm, funny, and rarely heavy.
-   Dub:   Very accessible and easy to enjoy.
Why it’s high: probably the   smoothest shared watch   if you want something fun and low-stress.
-   Character arcs:   Excellent, especially if you like underdog growth and team chemistry.
Why it isn’t  1: it’s fantastic for arcs, but if you want the strongest immediate personal growth in fewer hours,   Mob Psycho 100   edges it out.
-   Character arcs:   Strong in a psychological sense, though not especially warm or uplifting.
-   Dub:   One of the better-known anime dubs.
Why it falls: great series, but it clashes with your   “not too depressing”   preference more than the top 3.
-   Tone:   Balanced overall, but includes some heavy material.
-   Time:   This is the main issue—season 1 length typically lands   just over   your preferred cap depending on how you count it.
Why it’s lower than its quality suggests: this is arguably the   best show overall  , but not the cleanest fit for your specific first-season time limit.
-   Tone:   Extremely intense, grim, and often brutal.
Why it ranks last: it fails your   “not too depressing”   preference the hardest. If mood matters, this is the one to avoid first.
Best Choice Depending on Your Mood
-   Best if you want something lighter/funnier:     Spy x Family
-   Best if you want inspiring growth and teamwork:     Haikyuu!!
-   Best if you want suspense over comfort:     Death Note
-   Best long-term masterpiece, if you can stretch the time limit:     Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
